title: Derived exchange for a torsion sheaf over an algebraically closed base field
statement: Let k be algebraically closed, K any extension field, f:X -> Spec k qcqs, n nonzero in k, and F an abelian etale sheaf on X with n times its identity zero. With g:Spec K -> Spec k and its pullback square, the exact derived inverse image of Rf_*(F[0]) is isomorphic to Rf\prime_*((p^*F)[0]). Derived direct images here are the total right-derived functors of the inverse-image adjunctions [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image].

source.place: Lemma 59.90.1; perfect-base separable case, using Tags 07BV and 0F09

proof.text: An algebraically closed field is perfect. The perfect-field transcendence-basis theorem makes every finitely generated intermediate field separably generated, so K/k is separable.

Express K as the filtered colimit of its finitely generated smooth k-subalgebras. Construct the opposite Spec diagram over Spec k and its cone at Spec K from the actual inclusions. Spec maps the ring colimit to a scheme limit. Stage maps are smooth; structure and transition maps are affine, so qcqs.

Apply smooth-stage exchange followed by affine inverse-limit exchange to this actual diagram. This proves the desired derived isomorphism. K need not be algebraically closed; n=0 is excluded, n=1 forces F=0, and empty X gives zero objects.

theorem nonempty_fieldExtension_derivedDirectImage_single_iso
    {k K : Type u} [Field k] [Field K] [IsAlgClosed k] [Algebra k K]
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (n : ℕ) (hn : (n : k) ≠ 0)
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (hF : n • 𝟙 F = 0) :
    Nonempty
      (((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))).mapDerivedCategory).obj
          ((lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).rightDerivedFunctor.obj
            ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj F)) ≅
        (lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
          (pullback.snd f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))))).rightDerivedFunctor.obj
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
            ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
              (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))))).obj F)))
